ops.title: Index escalation refusal candidates by referenced PR
ops.description: Owner /root/long_running_watch_flakes_ship. Root chose independent A route-key lookups/read ownership now and requested simplest B storage contract in parallel. Actual last_refusal still loads every RUNNER escalation for every selected member before checking refusal tag, PR word boundary and accepted_at. A deliberately leaves that N-history component. Freeze a same-existing-SQLite indexed candidate lookup, preserving record JSON/Book codec, exact caller PR/head/time/tie/error semantics, mutable targets and old Store writers. No new daemon, timer, operational parallel store, automatic migration or fallback. Existing action table has indexed kind/status/ordinal but PR mentions are embedded arbitrary target text and can be multiple per action; time-only expression index cannot bound the existing all-recent unrelated-history control. Concrete candidate contract goes in FE/lr-escalation-reference-index-contract.json for Root review before implementation; manual one-host physical index provision must precede publication. Carry exact source/CI old negatives and Unicode/multiple-reference/old-writer tests through independent review, normal merge/release/install/adoption/affected proof. No local tests/builds/benchmarks or live trace.

ops.text: Concrete indexed candidate fields/query/update/delete and old-writer contract is accepted; existing history, multi-member, Unicode boundary, timestamps and errors are preserved without fallback or Book codec change.
Actual caller and legacy writer CI at32/10000 unrelated records prove selected-candidate work, fresh updates/deletes and exact output, with independent final-source review.
Reviewed one-host physical provisioning precedes normal publication; exact installed source and actual controller adoption plus bounded affected proof complete.
